"""Controlled Task API sample: SQLite persistence and WSGI JSON endpoints."""

import json
import sqlite3


class TaskAPI:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        with sqlite3.connect(path) as db:
            db.execute(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)"
            )

    def request(self, method, path, body):
        parts = path.strip("/").split("/")
        if not parts or parts[0] != "tasks":
            return 404, {"error": "not found"}
        with sqlite3.connect(self.path) as db:
            db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            if method == "POST" and len(parts) == 1:
                title = body.get("title")
                if not isinstance(title, str) or not 1 <= len(title.strip()) <= 200:
                    return 400, {"error": "title required, at most 200 characters"}
                cursor = db.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO tasks(title) VALUES (?)", (title.strip(),)
                )
                return 201, dict(
                    db.execute(
                        "SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id=?", (cursor.lastrowid,)
                    ).fetchone()
                )
            if method == "GET" and len(parts) == 1:
                return 200, [
                    dict(row) for row in db.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks ORDER BY id")
                ]
            if len(parts) != 2 or not parts[1].isdigit():
                return 404, {"error": "not found"}
            task_id = int(parts[1])
            if not db.execute("SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE id=?", (task_id,)).fetchone():
                return 404, {"error": "not found"}
            if method == "PATCH":
                if not body or set(body) - {"title", "completed"}:
                    return 400, {"error": "invalid fields"}
                if "title" in body:
                    title = body["title"]
                    if not isinstance(title, str) or not 1 <= len(title.strip()) <= 200:
                        return 400, {"error": "invalid title"}
                if "completed" in body and not isinstance(body["completed"], bool):
                    return 400, {"error": "completed must be boolean"}
                if "title" in body:
                    db.execute(
                        "UPDATE tasks SET title=? WHERE id=?",
                        (body["title"].strip(), task_id),
                    )
                if "completed" in body:
                    db.execute(
                        "UPDATE tasks SET completed=? WHERE id=?",
                        (body["completed"], task_id),
                    )
                return 200, dict(
                    db.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id=?", (task_id,)).fetchone()
                )
            if method == "DELETE":
                db.execute("DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id=?", (task_id,))
                return 200, {"deleted": task_id}
            return 405, {"error": "method not allowed"}

    def __call__(self, environ, start_response):
        try:
            length = int(environ.get("CONTENT_LENGTH") or 0)
            if length < 0 or length > 4096:
                raise ValueError()
            raw = environ["wsgi.input"].read(length)
            body = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
            if not isinstance(body, dict):
                raise TypeError()
            status, result = self.request(
                environ["REQUEST_METHOD"], environ["PATH_INFO"], body
            )
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            status, result = 400, {"error": "invalid JSON request"}
        payload = json.dumps(result).encode()
        start_response(
            str(status) + " Response",
            [
                ("Content-Type", "application/json"),
                ("Content-Length", str(len(payload))),
            ],
        )
        return [payload]
